scope: Quality comparison on three identical immutable 64 MiB images; no commercial speed comparison. All source images rehashed after all product runs.

rescue.mode: quick filesystem metadata scan; all supported candidates; defaults; three warm-cache runs

ufs.license: Free evaluation, copied files <=256 KiB; largest corpus file 36,642 bytes

settings.ntfs: Entire image, NTFS only, raw/signature recovery disabled; first recognized NTFS result; select all root files
settings.fat32: Entire image, FAT only, raw/signature recovery disabled; recognized FAT result; select all root files
settings.exfat: Recognized ExFAT partition, index filesystem then scan unused space, default filesystem detectors, raw/signature recovery disabled; recovered root files. Initial disk-level exFAT-only scan found no result.

dmde.license: Free Edition, up to 4000 files from active panel per operation; this corpus has 36 files in one directory

settings.all: readonly=1, documented notadmin=1 for regular image access; no raw/signature recovery; recover deleted files from active root directory
settings.ntfs: Whole-image NTFS scan; NTFS additional result 0; root files
settings.fat32: Whole-image FAT scan found no result; opened recognized FAT32 partition and recovered immediately visible deleted root files
settings.exfat: Opened recognized ExFAT partition; accepted Auto detect FS parameters, whole-image exFAT scan, raw disabled; ExFAT main result 0; active root directory

r_studio.reason: Linux executable required administrator authentication before image access; not scored. No password or license bypass attempted.

not_measured: commercial RAID, read-error and quick-format comparison
large commercial files beyond evaluation limits

original_deletion_methods.independent-ntfs: ntfs-3g generated; emulated deletion clears MFT in-use bit; allocation bitmap and directory index retained
original_deletion_methods.independent-fat32: dosfstools + mtools; actual mdel deletion clears multi-cluster chains; same denominator includes unrecoverable metadata cases
original_deletion_methods.independent-exfat: exfatprogs formatted; emulated deleted contiguous directory entries inserted in free clusters
